title: Intrinsic Bias is Predicted by Pretraining Data and Correlates with Downstream Performance in Vision-Language Encoders

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding Association Tests (EATs) measuring cosine similarity between embeddings of European American vs. African American stimuli (images and text) and valence attributes (pleasant vs. unpleasant) across unimodal and cross-modal settings.
